entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Alibaba took Tanaka's Shady[n]Commodities down? Want us[n]to check it out?

entries.speaker: Yusuke

entries.en: Is your room OK? It would be[n]best to meet as close to where[n]Futaba lives as possible.
